why_ai: Offshore support contacts and back-office processing are exactly what AI agents are already absorbing.
why_clarity: Scripted contacts repeat by the million, but resolution is estimated from samples and surveys.
why_digital: Contacts and back-office tasks are handled remotely on screens, often from abroad.

why_ai: Assist tools are themselves AI and become redundant as contacts resolve without agents.
why_clarity: Retrieved answers recur at volume, but agents cannot always tell when an answer is wrong.
why_digital: Knowledge bases and generated answers live entirely in software.

why_ai: Gaps and stale content are detectable from contacts, so AI can maintain the knowledge base.
why_clarity: Accuracy is checkable per article, but ownership is unclear and completeness is fuzzy.
why_digital: Content is authored and consumed digitally by remote agents.

why_ai: Renegotiating what clients pay for is an adversarial commercial contest with almost no engineering in it.
why_clarity: Each contract renegotiation is one-off and its commercial success shows only over years.
why_digital: Inputs are contracts and metrics, but deals are struck in enterprise relationship negotiations.

why_ai: The niche is the automation itself, and managing its residue is measurable analytics work.
why_clarity: Deflection rates and downstream handle-time effects are measurable from contact data.
why_digital: Contact data in, deflection flows and analysis out, all in software.

why_ai: Scoring every transcribed contact replaces the human two percent sample directly.
why_clarity: A clean corpus with observable repeat contacts gives an objective outcome signal.
why_digital: Transcribed, timestamped contacts are scored entirely by software.

why_ai: High-volume screening and attrition prediction are well-posed tasks already largely automated.
why_clarity: Recruiting cohorts repeat constantly, though attrition causes take months to confirm.
why_digital: Applications and assessments are digital, with interviews and training cohorts partly in person.

why_ai: Resolution measurement from complete contact records is a direct AI task.
why_clarity: Resolution is the agreed target, but it is inferred from tiny samples and surveys.
why_digital: Every contact is recorded and assessed on screens.

why_ai: Most of the analyst role is listening and rubric scoring that AI does, leaving some coaching.
why_clarity: Rubric scoring repeats on every contact, though rubrics measure the wrong thing.
why_digital: Analysts work from recordings and dashboards, with team leaders coaching on site.

why_ai: Contact handling is being deflected and resolved by AI, leaving a shrinking residual workforce.
why_clarity: Scripted contacts repeat endlessly, but harder residual cases blur what good looks like.
why_digital: Agents work entirely on screens, usually offshore.

why_ai: Interval forecasting and Erlang scheduling are the most modelled, automatable work in the industry.
why_clarity: Forecast misses show within the interval against codified staffing methods.
why_digital: Arrival data in, schedules out, all in workforce software.
